notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Carrion Feeder.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
